postconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the permutation n is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element of the permutation is an integer between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: All elements in a permutation are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of subsequences k is between 1 and f(n), inclusive, where f(n) is the minimum integer k such that every permutation of length n can be partitioned into at most k monotonic subsequences.

postconditions.expression: Each subsequence is either increasing or decreasing.
postconditions.description: Each subsequence in the partition is monotonic, either increasing or decreasing.

postconditions.expression: Each element of the permutation belongs to exactly one subsequence.
postconditions.description: Every element in the permutation is included in exactly one of the subsequences.
